summary: This Phase 2 clinical trial compared the effects of BGM0504 injection versus semaglutide injection in adults who are obese or overweight. A total of 60 participants took part in the study to measure changes in body weight and how the body handles insulin, a hormone that controls blood sugar. The trial was sponsored by the Second Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University and is now Completed.
